decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage builds directly on the firm's core drainage and bathroom expertise, so absorptive capacity is high and withdrawal risk remains low.
The designer shower drainage product aligns with the firm's design-led, integrated drainage direction and existing knowledge, making it easy to interpret and improve.
Shower elements with integrated slope extend the firm's installation and waterproofing know-how into accessible, low-profile solutions, supporting continued learning.
Backflow-protected basement floor drains leverage proven drainage technology and technical installation knowledge within the firm's core domain.
Air-admittance valves are weakly related to the firm's core drainage manufacturing and design knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate results and improve the product.
